entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It will reveal itself to you when..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will reveal itself to you when the time is right."

entries.title: Narrator: "Sal motioned towards a secluded cor..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal motioned towards a secluded corner of the garden, nestled beneath a tree. His voice softened to a whisper as we approached.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The significance of our religious..."
entries.dialogueText: "The significance of our religious laws cannot be overstated. However, they mark the beginning, not the end..."

entries.dialogueText: "The clergy wields significant influence within Rizia's Wruhecist community, with their reach extending into institutions such as the military."

entries.dialogueText: "If we were to unite them -- an army of God, if you will -- such a coalition would bolster the Crown's authority like never before."

entries.dialogueText: As I rounded a curve in the path, the garden revealed itself in all its splendor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manicured hedges surrounded patches..."
entries.dialogueText: Manicured hedges surrounded patches of blooming flowers, with ornate lamps on wrought-iron posts shedding light over the twisting gravel paths.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a stark contrast to the aust..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a stark contrast to the austere council chambers I had just left.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""To distance yourself from them is..."
entries.dialogueText: "To distance yourself from them is to distance yourself from your own humanity."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's time the Crown transferred it..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's time the Crown transferred its law-making powers to elected representatives."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Then we'll have to make sure nobod..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then we'll have to make sure nobody has the ability to intervene or execute a power grab before the new constitution is signed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus looked at me in shock and dis..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus looked at me in shock and disbelief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He couldn't bring himself to finish..."
entries.dialogueText: He couldn't bring himself to finish the sentence.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's not like that.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's not like that."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Their cries for civil liberties ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their cries for civil liberties are reaching a fever pitch."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""A governance rooted in faith -- on..."
entries.dialogueText: "A governance rooted in faith -- one that embraces God's law above the laws of men -- is not just the best choice, but the only way forward for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A theocracy.""
entries.dialogueText: "A theocracy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you're still hell-bent on estab..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you're still hell-bent on establishing a divine monarchy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A holy takeover.""
entries.dialogueText: "A holy takeover."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Exactly, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Heaven-bent is more like it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Heaven-bent is more like it."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I like to think of it more as a ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like to think of it more as a holy *liberation*."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your faith-based decrees have pave..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your faith-based decrees have paved the way for a prosperous future."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The classroom is the place to rein..."
entries.dialogueText: "The classroom is the place to reinforce religious teachings, instilling values that uphold our cultural identity and moral principles."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we made our way there, his voice..."
entries.dialogueText: As we made our way there, his voice softened to a whisper.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Praise God! I had faith you'd even..."
entries.dialogueText: "Praise God! I had faith you'd eventually come around."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Faith teaches that divine providen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Faith teaches that divine providence guides us through all trials, both spiritual and earthly. Those who challenge it often find themselves on precarious ground."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""An honor as always.""
entries.dialogueText: "An honor as always."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""All that's needed is for you to op..."
entries.dialogueText: "All that's needed is for you to open it and lead your people through."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal's eyes went wide, but he mainta..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal's eyes went wide, but he maintained his composure.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You thought wrong.""
entries.dialogueText: "You thought wrong."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Well, I appreciate your honesty. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I appreciate your honesty. Though, I can't say I'm not disappointed."

entries.dialogueText: "Let me guess. The new leader's named Adarfo."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I see you're already aware of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see you're already aware of the situation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you telling me that RPP has be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you telling me that RPP has been infiltrated by communists?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? How did you allow this to ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? How did you allow this to happen? I thought the RPP listened to you."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "It's not that simple."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "And who did they appoint in your place?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you can't nip this in the bud,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you can't nip this in the bud, I'll have no choice but to hold you personally responsible."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I'm sorry, Your Majesty. I did my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Your Majesty. I did my best."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "They elected Adarfo Sotelato, a relatively new member of the party. He has been leading the left-wing faction of the RPP."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes. Mr. Sotelato is the new leade..."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""He and they are the driving force..."
entries.dialogueText: "He and they are the driving force behind the recent protests."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "I did my best to convince my fellow party members of the merits of a slow democratic change that respected our traditions and the Crown..."
